claims: 2 Chronicles 7:11–22 records God’s response to Solomon after the Temple dedication.
Solomon successfully completes the Temple and his palace before the divine appearance in 2 Chronicles 7:11–22.
The divine appearance in 2 Chronicles 7:11–22 happens at night.
2 Chronicles 7:12-16 describes God choosing the Temple as a place for sacrifice and hearing prayer.

2 Chronicles 7:12-16 records God promising: "if my people... humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land".
2 Chronicles 7:17-22 records God telling Solomon that if he and his descendants turn away, serve other gods, and break the covenant, Israel will be uprooted from the land.
2 Chronicles 7:17-22 records God telling Solomon that if he and his descendants turn away, serve other gods, and break the covenant, the Temple will be ruined.
